description: Plan one device across KernelCAD and LabWired. Read-only: returns companion tool names, project/revision links, the electronics-to-mechanics handoff, and a Buy device review link. Use for robots, enclosures, PCB mounts or any hardware with electronics and mechanical parts. Optional slug resolves an accessible saved KernelCAD project; pass version to pin an immutable CAD revision, otherwise its current revision is used. Optional labwired_project/labwired_revision preserves its electronics reference. No purchase, payment, account linking, source upload or companion authorization is performed.

labwired_pcb.description: LabWired PCB board id, including PCB-only handoffs.

labwired_project.description: LabWired project id returned by LabWired; a reference, not authorization.

labwired_revision.description: LabWired content hash/revision returned by LabWired.

labwired_share.description: LabWired share/lab id for an unsaved lab; use this or labwired_project.

slug.description: Saved KernelCAD project slug; current revision is read with existing project permissions.

version.description: Immutable KernelCAD revision to preserve. Requires slug; omitted means current revision.

name: hardware_pack
title: Build with LabWired and KernelCAD
